document.title: Tag-triggered VPK release and npm trusted publishing
document.summary: Pushing a bare semver tag now builds the VPK, publishes `@vitadeck/sdk` over npm Trusted Publishing and creates the GitHub Release. The Vita image is pinned, QuickJS `CONFIG_VERSION` comes from the submodule, and `PSVITAIP` moves to the environment.
document.why: GitHub Releases and npm publishes are cut by hand, and the Vita image floats on unpinned `latest` and branch heads ([#52](source:s1)).

sources.title: Release automation
sources.gist: Approved proposal: release.yml on bare semver tags reusing vita-build.yml, npm trusted publishing, pre-release on 0.x, pinned Docker image and clones, QuickJS version from submodule, PSVITAIP from env.

sources.label: Orchestrator brief · Oct 25
sources.gist: Implement #52 as approved; fail early on tag/version mismatch; align action versions; document the one-time npm setup.

lookFor: Manual step: release publishing fails until Máté adds a Trusted Publisher for `release.yml` on npmjs.com under `@vitadeck/sdk` settings ([#52](source:s1)).
Done differently: the proposal checks the tag inside `publish`; the code runs it in its own `check-version` job before `vpk`, so a mismatch fails before the Docker build ([brief](source:s2)).
Not in the proposal: `upload-vdapp.sh` drops its CMake cache and `CMakeLists.txt` IP fallbacks, since `CMakeLists.txt` no longer holds an IP.

groups.title: Release workflow
groups.why: A pushed tag cuts the release instead of hand steps ([#52](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `release.yml` checks the tag against the SDK version, calls `vita-build.yml` through its new `workflow_call` with the tag as `version`, then publishes the packed SDK and attaches the downloaded VPK to `gh release create`.
lookFor: Subtle: `npm publish` runs before `gh release create`, so if the release step fails, re-running the job fails at publish because that npm version already exists; the release then needs a manual `gh release create`.

groups.title: VPK version from the tag
groups.why: The Vita wants `XX.YY`, so the release tag maps to the VPK version ([#52](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `VITADECK_VERSION=0.6.0` becomes `VITA_VERSION` `00.06` and anything not `X.Y.Z` is a configure error; the `PSVITAIP` line in the same hunk belongs to the env group.
lookFor: Untagged builds keep `VITA_VERSION` `01.00`, so CI and local VPKs report a higher version than 0.x releases such as `00.06`.

groups.title: Pinned Vita image
groups.why: The image used `gnuton/vitasdk-docker:latest` and unpinned `--depth=1` clones ([#52](source:s1)).
groups.summary: The Dockerfile pins the base image by digest and checks out fixed SDL and raylib-5.5-vita commits like vitaGL, and the GHA cache scope moves to `v3` so no layer from the floating image is reused.

groups.title: QuickJS CONFIG_VERSION from the submodule
groups.why: The hard-coded `2024-01-13` was independent of the submodule ([#52](source:s1)).
groups.summary: CMake reads the first line of `vendor/quickjs/VERSION` into `CONFIG_VERSION` and reconfigures when that file changes.

groups.title: PSVITAIP from the environment
groups.why: A personal IP was baked into `CMakeLists.txt` ([#52](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `PSVITAIP` comes from `$ENV{PSVITAIP}` at configure time, a `require_psvitaip` target fails `upload_vpk` and `upload_vita` when it is empty, Compose passes it into the container, and the skills and `AGENTS.md` say how to set it.
lookFor: Subtle: an existing `out-vita` with the old cached `PSVITAIP=192.168.1.177` no longer uploads; the plain `set()` shadows the cache entry, so `cmake --build out-vita --target run` fails with the unset message until `PSVITAIP` is exported and CMake re-runs.
`upload-vdapp.sh` with no `--ip` and no `PSVITAIP` now exits 1 instead of reading `out-vita/CMakeCache.txt`.

groups.title: Releasing doc
groups.why: Máté needs the two release steps and the one-time npm setup written down ([brief](source:s2)).
groups.summary: `docs/releasing.md` lists the version-bump PR, the tag push and the Trusted Publisher setup, and `AGENTS.md` links it.

groups.title: Aligned action versions
groups.why: The issue notes the workflows used different `setup-buildx` and `build-push-action` majors ([brief](source:s2)).
groups.summary: The `smoke` job in `ci.yml` moves to `setup-buildx-action@v4`, `build-push-action@v7` and `upload-artifact@v6`, the versions `vita-build.yml` already uses; the reader can skim it.
